Changelog 👾

BionicLM Studio
Bionic 1.1.1

Bionic 1.1.1

  • Significant UI performance improvements
  • Fixed project Git branch details becoming stale after repository changes.
  • New "Agent" section in App Settings
  • Fixed moving a forked session also moving its parent session.
  • Session status indicators on collapsed projects.
  • localhost links can now open in App Browser or the system browser.
  • Auto name session after forking and user message send
  • More reliable agent use of available skills.
  • New top bar icons and improved sidebar spacing.
  • llama.cpp 2.31.2 extension packs.
  • Fixed tabs reacting to drags from other windows.
  • Fixed the composer losing focus after sending the first message from a new tab.
Aug 31, 2026
Bionic 1.1.0

Bionic 1.1.0

  • Project-less chats
  • Auto Review for shell commands
  • Simpler project creation: unify code and work project types, with optional coding abilities per session
  • Support for Images in tool call results in the /v1/responses, /v1/chat/completions, and /v1/messages APIs
  • Git agent instructions adjustment
  • llama.cpp 2.31.0 extension packs
  • Fewer approval prompts for shell commands implied by your request.
  • Fixed right panel headers blocking window dragging.
  • Localized standard reasoning-level labels for LM Link models.
  • More consistent Project Files folder controls and previews.
  • Security hardening
  • Word document comments and tracked changes omit timestamps unless requested.
  • Project code-permission guidance in the New Project modal.
  • Fewer approval prompts for safe read-only GitHub queries.
  • Fixed LM Link connections to newly discovered peers.
  • Vision subagents: set a local or cloud model to be process images
  • Fewer approval prompts for additional safe shell commands.
  • Persistent shell approval preferences and custom Auto Review instructions.
  • Fewer approval prompts for safe LMS and ESLint commands.
  • Cross-project session moves.
  • Fixed the command approval tooltip remaining visible after opening the menu.
  • Consistent sizing and spacing for composer controls.
  • Fixed transcription stop button colors.
  • No-project session section in the sidebar
  • Composer controls for disabled, manual review, auto review, and allow-all shell modes.
  • Vision subagents for letting text-only models understand images.
  • Local model loading and prompt-processing progress in transcripts.
  • MLX prompt disk cache controls in advanced model settings.
  • Muse Glimmer tool calling for MLX models.
  • Fixed composer chips disappearing across draft edits.
  • Fixed the GPU settings pop-out.
  • Fixed some UI lags while the agent is working
  • Fixed shell commands failing with zsh configurations that replace default aliases.
  • llama.cpp 2.30.0 extension packs.
  • Fixed transcript scroll position jumping during tool interactions.
  • UI performance improvements
  • More reliable LM Link connections during high-volume activity.
  • Fixed Office document previews failing after a cancelled conversion.
  • 2–2.75× faster prompt processing on M5 Macs.
  • Fewer approval prompts for safe read-only shell and GitHub commands.
  • Syntax highlighting for more languages in project file previews.
  • Horizontal scrollbars for wide Markdown tables now appear on hover.
Aug 27, 2026
Bionic 1.0.9

Bionic 1.0.9

  • Web URLs can be opened directly from quick open.
  • Fixed bugs relating to creating and using skills with some models
  • Rich Markdown formatting when copying assistant messages.
  • Large shell outputs retain their beginning and end when truncated.
  • PDF processing support for larger embedded images.
  • Fixed malformed JSON errors caused by invalid text characters.
  • Better alignment for fallback model thumbnails.
  • Cleaner open-file search without spellcheck underlines.
Aug 18, 2026
Bionic 1.0.8

Bionic 1.0.8

  • Skills onboarding affordance under the chat input box.
  • Skill suggestions in the new session composer.
  • Create Skill onboarding now invokes the skill in new chats.
  • Fixed Code Review slash command order ranking.
  • @ mention support for external project files
  • Fixed composer suggestions clipping behind tabs or while scrolling.
  • Fixed composer suggestions not loading in the launchpad.
  • Clearer inclusion controls and excluded status for external skills.
  • New /install-skill and /create-skill commands.
  • Friendlier names for built-in document and slide skills.
  • Skill suggestions in chat with @, with references preserved in chat history.
  • Guided skill setup from chat and settings.
  • Skill management with enable/disable controls, details, and file actions.
  • File type icons in projects and composer search.
  • Clearer cloud plan, credit, and usage details.
  • Fixed per-folder skill toggles and .agents skill discovery.
  • Fixed inline math overflowing messages.
  • Fixed PDF preview scrollbar flicker.
  • Fixed audio visualization bars getting stuck at peak.
  • Fixed completed subagent rows appearing active.
  • Fixed app overload when a session has a lot of compactions.
  • Fixed bug where content in API responses was unexpectedly fragmented.
  • Clearer button to complete authentication for OAuth MCP servers.
  • Fixed system language preferences not being honored in order.
  • Cleaner work duration labels.
  • Fixed local API server start/stop errors not appearing in settings.
  • Fixed missing space in the context length label.
  • Fixed localized button labels wrapping.
  • Fixed Python output paths after rewinding a session.
Aug 17, 2026
Bionic 1.0.7

Bionic 1.0.7

  • Support for new models
  • Fixed inability to drag the window from settings titles.
  • Added support for making the app window show always on top (right click on tab strip)
  • Diagram, chart, and data visualization creation support.
  • Fixed audio waveform saturation after silent microphone startup.
  • GitHub-style line ranges now appear as clickable project file chips.
  • File or folder drag and drop anywhere in a session tab to attach.
  • Simplified Chinese interface support based on system language.
  • More compact work duration labels.
Aug 10, 2026
Bionic 1.0.6

Bionic 1.0.6

  • Agent can now use sandboxed (Pyodide) operations for encryption, signatures, and other cryptography tasks.
  • Improve audio waveform UI to better reflect spoken volume.
  • Right-click browser tabs to open a new browser tab.
  • Refreshed tab icons for clearer tab types.
  • More consistent progress indicators while tools and subagents are running.
  • More reliable automatic shell-command reviews during long sessions.
  • Right-click action menus for generated file banners.
  • Simpler spreadsheet defaults and clearer PowerPoint creation guidance.
  • Fewer web searches for local and LM Link models to avoid context overload.
  • Stable widths for live progress numbers.
  • Clearer Code Project folder icons.
  • Fixed issue with the Working... animation disappearing and reappearing rapidly
Aug 7, 2026
Bionic 1.0.5

Bionic 1.0.5

  • Addressed cases where local models failed to process file attachments
  • Fixed extra spacing after expanded work traces.
  • Fixed truncated model names in the model picker.
  • Folder attachments in the composer.
  • More accurate progress indicators during multi-step work.
  • File export actions for regular projects.
  • More responsive microphone level visualization.
  • New Bionic tray icon.
  • Automatic context sizing for local MLX models based on available memory.
  • Faster processing for large files, with support for files up to 100 MiB.
  • Image and PDF previews now support files up to 100 MiB.
  • Bionic can now download public files up to 100 MiB, with improved compatibility for sites such as Wikimedia.
  • Improved transcript scrollbar visibility and positioning.
  • Clearer paths for edited files outside the project folder.
  • Open in Split action for edited files.
  • Smoother long transcript loading and scrolling.
  • Clearer right-panel toggle alignment.
  • Clearer follow-up message prompt while sessions are running.
  • Native file-manager actions for project files.
  • Unread indicator when more sessions are hidden.
  • Permission prompts for destructive file deletion operations.
  • More accessible disabled buttons and tooltips.
  • Fixed incorrect UI label indicating authentication required to use MCP servers.
  • Fixed sidebar control alignment.
  • Fixed inconsistent modal shadows.
  • Fix Windows header controls, color, and alignment
  • More responsive image and PDF processing.
  • Clearer working indicator during pauses in streamed responses.
Aug 5, 2026

Bionic 1.0.4

  • Reasoning-level submenu hover and keyboard navigation improvements.
  • More consistent spacing between completed responses and the composer.
  • Fixed context-length tooltip placement in model settings.
  • Fixed auto scroll after overflow during dictation
  • Fixed unsupported PDF tool appearing on Windows.
  • Guided first-project setup for new workspaces.
  • Cleaner new-project setup with clearer folder options.
  • Persistent New Project action while scrolling workspaces.
  • More consistent image and PDF processing quality.
  • Fixed empty project-file sidebar alignment.
  • Smoother project-folder options in new-project setup.
  • More visible New Project actions in workspaces.
  • Clearer browser sign-in progress for cloud models.
  • Fixed duplicate and temporary file banners in coding projects.
  • Faster project file search for coding agents.
  • Clearer write-access requests for coding agents.
  • More visible recent sessions in multi-project workspaces.
  • Composer footer and project-file sidebar alignment polish.
  • Fixed image dragging from outside the image preview.
  • Clearer Coding project description.
  • Fixed transparent sticky headers in the model downloads panel.
  • Streamlined new-project setup with a Coding project toggle and folder picker.
  • Distinct sidebar icons for Work and Code projects.
  • Embedding model support.
  • Selectable transcript file path chips.
  • Native macOS text context menu actions.
  • Fixed local-model continuation after interrupted reasoning-only turns.
  • Smoother file preview opening and cross-project reloads.
  • Clearer tool request and response details.
  • More actionable llama-server startup errors.

Bionic 1.0.3

Bionic 1.0.3

  • Markdown preview and slash-command spacing polish.
  • Fixed LM Link compatibility handling for remote context-length lookups.
  • Fixed app icon sizing on Windows.
  • Document tools for the coding agent.
  • LM Link remote model configuration and loaded-instance status in the Model Library.
  • Voice model auto-loading tuned to available Mac memory.
  • Safer handling of destructive Git commands.
  • Fixed Gemma 4 native tool-use detection.
  • Runtime downloads hidden by default for a cleaner downloads list.

Bionic 1.0.2

Bionic 1.0.2

  • UX improvement in model picker
  • Refresh cloud model list when refreshing billing information in Settings
  • Nicer UX showing when skills are used
  • Fix Settings title bar not draggable
  • MCP OAuth fixes, including public discovery, reauthentication, and custom scopes.
  • Fix issue with model model selection not persisting after project creation
  • Upon project creation, create a new tab in that project
  • Fixed first-run onboarding for Bionic 1.0.x.
